FAQ.title: Frequently Asked Questions
FAQ.desc: Find clear answers about medical treatment in India, including hospitals, doctors, treatment costs, medical visas, travel, accommodation, and patient support. Our FAQs help international patients understand the process and plan their medical journey with confidence.

q1.question: What is medical tourism in India?
q1.answer: Medical tourism means traveling to India for medical treatment, surgery, diagnosis, or healthcare services.

q2.question: Why choose India for medical treatment?
q2.answer: India offers experienced doctors, advanced hospitals, modern technology, and affordable treatment options.

q3.question: What services does your company provide?
q3.answer: We provide hospital coordination, doctor appointments, medical treatment support, travel assistance, accommodation, and patient coordination.

q4.question: Can you help me choose a hospital?
q4.answer: Yes, we can help you find a suitable hospital based on your medical needs and preferences.

q5.question: Can you help me choose a doctor?
q5.answer: Yes, we can help arrange consultation with a suitable specialist.

q6.question: Can I send my medical reports before traveling?
q6.answer: Yes. You can share your medical reports for review and treatment planning.

q7.question: Can you provide a treatment estimate?
q7.answer: Yes, we can request a treatment estimate from the hospital based on your medical reports.

q8.question: Do you arrange doctor appointments?
q8.answer: Yes, we can arrange appointments with doctors and specialists.

q9.question: Do you provide language interpretation?
q9.answer: Yes, we provide language interpretation and communication support for international patients.

q10.question: Do you help with a medical visa?
q10.answer: Yes, we can provide guidance and coordination for the medical visa process.

q11.question: Do you arrange airport pickup?
q11.answer: Yes, we can arrange airport pickup and transportation as required.

q12.question: Do you arrange accommodation?
q12.answer: Yes, we can help arrange suitable accommodation near the hospital.

q13.question: Do you provide local transportation?
q13.answer: Yes, transportation can be arranged for hospital visits, airport transfers, and other necessary travel.

q14.question: Will someone assist me during my hospital visit?
q14.answer: Yes, our patient coordinator can assist with hospital communication and coordination.

q15.question: Can family members travel with the patient?
q15.answer: Yes, family members can travel with the patient, subject to visa and travel requirements.

q16.question: Can you help after the treatment?
q16.answer: Yes, we can assist with follow-up appointments, reports, and other post-treatment coordination.

q17.question: How long will my treatment take?
q17.answer: The treatment duration depends on the patient's condition, treatment plan, and doctor's recommendation.

q18.question: How much does treatment in India cost?
q18.answer: The cost depends on the hospital, doctor, treatment, medical condition, and required services.

q19.question: How do I start my medical treatment journey in India?
q19.answer: Send us your medical reports and requirements. We will guide you through the next steps.

q20.question: Why choose our medical tourism company?
q20.answer: We provide end-to-end support to help international patients have a smooth, organized, and comfortable medical journey in India.

q21.question: Why should I choose India for medical treatment?
q21.answer: India offers world-class medical facilities, internationally accredited hospitals (JCI & NABH), highly skilled doctors trained in the US/UK, and advanced medical technology at 60–80% lower costs compared to Western nations, with virtually zero waiting times.

q22.question: Will there be a language barrier during my hospital stay?
q22.answer: No. English is the official operational language across all accredited Indian hospitals. Furthermore, our team assigns a dedicated translator (Arabic, Russian, French, Bengali, Swahili) to assist you during all consultations and hospital admissions.

q23.question: How do I obtain an Indian Medical Visa (Med Visa)?
q23.answer: Once you share your medical reports and select your preferred hospital, we arrange an official Visa Invitation Letter (VIL) from the hospital. You can use this to obtain an e-Medical Visa online within 48 to 72 hours.

q24.question: Can family members or attendants travel with me?
q24.answer: Yes, up to two family members or attendants can travel with you on a Medical Attendant Visa (MED-X). The official hospital invitation letter will explicitly include their details.

q25.question: How does the quotation and payment process work?
q25.answer: Our consultation and concierge coordination is 100% free for patients. All treatment payments are settled directly with the hospital upon arrival via credit card, bank wire transfer, or foreign currency.

q26.question: What happens when I land at the airport in India?
q26.answer: Our representative will receive you directly at the airport terminal with a personalized name placard, transport you to your hotel or hospital room, and provide you with a local SIM card and currency exchange assistance.

bottom.desc: Our medical assistance team is available 24/7 on WhatsApp & Phone.

reviews.quote: The NHS waitlist was over 18 months. With Asad Healthcare, I landed in Delhi on Monday, had robotic surgery on Wednesday, and was pain-free within weeks!
reviews.text: David suffered from severe osteoarthritis in both knees for over 4 years. Facing long waiting times in the UK, he contacted Asad Healthcare. Within 48 hours, he received detailed medical opinions from 3 top orthopedic surgeons. From airport reception to a private recovery suite, the care exceeded five-star hospitality.

reviews.quote: The Arabic translator assigned to me was with my family every single hour. Dr. Trehan and his team are world legends. May God bless them.
reviews.text: Tariq required an urgent quadruple heart bypass. Asad Healthcare coordinated the emergency medical visa within 24 hours. The surgery was performed using minimally invasive beating-heart techniques, resulting in rapid recovery and zero complications.

reviews.quote: We were told our daughter had no options back home. Apollo’s oncology team gave our child a second life with successful tumor resection.
reviews.text: The Adeleke family flew to New Delhi for specialized neuro-oncology treatment. The combination of high-precision image-guided surgery and dedicated post-operative pediatric intensive care ensured complete tumor clearance.

reviews.quote: From Russian-speaking patient coordinators to legal committee clearance in 5 days, everything was handled flawlessly. World-class transplant care.
reviews.text: Facing end-stage liver disease, Sergey received a living-donor transplant with his son as the donor. The complex 12-hour surgery achieved a 100% success rate, supported by comprehensive post-transplant infection isolation suites.

reviews.quote: I could not walk for more than 5 minutes due to nerve compression. Today I can stand straight and live without painkillers.
reviews.text: Grace underwent minimally invasive robotic spine decompression. The state-of-the-art neuro-monitoring ensured zero nerve injury and she returned to Kenya fully rehabilitated within 3 weeks.
